critical_carbapenemases.justification: Primary resistance mechanism for WHO 2024 Critical Priority pathogens: carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and Enterobacterales.

critical_esbl_cephalosporinases.justification: Resistance mechanism for WHO 2024 Critical Priority Enterobacterales (third-generation cephalosporin-resistant).

high_priority_colistin_resistance.justification: Critical mobile resistance mechanism against last-resort polymyxins, identified as a global surveillance priority by CDC and WHO.

high_priority_vancomycin_resistance.justification: Resistance mechanism for WHO 2024 High Priority Enterococcus faecium (vancomycin-resistant).

emerging_linezolid_resistance.justification: Mobile resistance genes for oxazolidinones, prioritized due to potential for rapid horizontal gene transfer in clinical and livestock settings.

surveillance_metadata.methodology: Cross-referenced WHO 2024 priority pathogen-resistance combinations with NCBI Pathogen Detection (AMRFinderPlus) canonical gene symbols.
